cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Gracious Command
cards.instruction: Remain warm and appreciative while steadily reducing everyone else’s room to choose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Thank you for helping me move. Would you rather pack books or plates?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Books, please. I'm nervous about breaking china.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. You're so careful. I've saved the plates for you; I'll do the books.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wrap them while you put them in boxes?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely idea. I'll leave the boxes beside you and take the books downstairs. You'll have the kitchen all to yourself.

mechanism: A warmly uses the pupil growth needs to reverse its choice of moving task and remove the shared-work compromise.
confusable: Not a sincere choice of practice: appreciative teaching language systematically leaves B the work it avoided.
comparison: Weather backup removed versus task preference and help withdrawn.
seedUse: D69 books/plates/wrapping/boxes; S05 practice confidence justifies unwanted assignment.
